requirement: Running `habeas setup` in an existing Cargo and mdBook project MUST add Habeas as a dev dependency, configure `habeas mdbook` as its preprocessor, add the badge stylesheet, enable sidebar folding with `output.html.fold.enable` unless the book already sets it, and create `tests/habeas.rs` that calls `habeas::validate()`. Repeating setup MUST avoid duplicate configuration and MUST NOT overwrite a differing test or stylesheet. Setup MUST NOT install or modify agent skills.
rationale:
I found no gaps. Every obligation in `requirements.cli.setup` has code reachable from the `{impl}` sites and a test that asserts its outcome.

Reachability: `src/main.rs` (`fn[main]/use@118842506675`) dispatches `Command::Setup` to `setup::run`. `run` calls `has_habeas_dev_dependency` and `write_new_or_same`, so all the setup code is reached from the `{impl}` items.

| Obligation | Code | Test |
|---|---|---|
| Add Habeas as a dev dependency | `setup::run` skips `cargo add --dev habeas` when `has_habeas_dev_dependency` is true. Otherwise it runs it, with `--path` when a local crate is given. | `setup_is_repeatable` asserts `[dev-dependencies]`, `habeas` and `path =` in `Cargo.toml`. |
| Configure `habeas mdbook` as the preprocessor | `run` sets `preprocessor.habeas.command = "habeas mdbook"` and `renderers = ["html"]`. | `setup_is_repeatable` asserts `command = "habeas mdbook"`. |
| Add the badge stylesheet | `run` adds it to `output.html.additional-css` without duplicating it, and `write_new_or_same` writes `habeas.css` in the book source directory. | `setup_is_repeatable` asserts the css file exists and `md/habeas.css` appears once in `book.toml`. |
| Enable sidebar folding unless the book already sets it | `run` inserts `fold.enable = true` only when `enable` is absent. It handles both table and inline-table forms. | `setup_keeps_an_existing_fold_setting` covers `enable = false`, `enable` absent, and an inline table. `setup_is_repeatable` asserts `enable` is true and appears once. |
| Create `tests/habeas.rs` calling `habeas::validate()` | `run` writes `TEST_SOURCE` through `write_new_or_same`. | `setup_is_repeatable` asserts the exact file contents. |
| Repeating setup avoids duplicate configuration | `run` skips `cargo add` when the dev dependency exists, dedups the css entry, and leaves an existing `enable` alone. TOML assignments are idempotent. | `setup_is_repeatable` runs setup twice and asserts a single css entry and a single `enable`. The cited `local_path_setup_*` tests cover the dev dependency. |
| MUST NOT overwrite a differing test or stylesheet | `run` pre-checks both files and returns "already exists with different content" before changing anything. `write_new_or_same` refuses a differing file too. | `setup_does_not_overwrite_a_differing_test_or_stylesheet` covers both `tests/habeas.rs` and `md/habeas.css`. It asserts failure, that the user content is kept, and that `book.toml` and `Cargo.toml` are unchanged. |
| MUST NOT install or modify agent skills | `run` has no skill-related code. | `setup_is_repeatable` asserts `.agents/skills` is never created. `setup_preserves_existing_agent_skills` asserts an existing skill file is unchanged. |

Unspecified behavior: validation errors for a bad `book.toml` and the success message are within the setup family. They are covered by the `setup_project` and `setup_css` requirements, which the same code marks `{impl}`.

Repeating setup MUST avoid duplicate configuration and MUST NOT overwrite a differing test or stylesheet. Setup MUST NOT install or modify agent skills.
